task_description: Phase 2 of the relay option the user chose (message 11): build the `ahead-relay` Cloudflare Worker (allowlist of the six Cloudflare-challenged sources importai, zvi, chinai, pod-dwarkesh, epoch-gradient-updates, thebatch; X-Relay-Token auth; KV last-good copy with 2 h freshness and stale fallback; cron every 3 h) and make the Ahead pipeline fetch those six sources through it when RELAY_URL and RELAY_TOKEN are set, with direct fallback, meta notes, token redaction, tests, workflow env and README. Plan: .agents/tasks/ahead-build/relay-build-plan.md (decisions D1-D14 are settled). Two sequential features: FEAT-001 config flags + allowlist generator + Worker + Worker tests + deploy + secrets; FEAT-002 pipeline relay path + http.js relay rules/redaction + refresh.yml env + tests + README. The workflow tail then runs a fixer/reviewer loop gated on relay-review.json and a finalize step that pushes, runs Actions and confirms the live meta.json.
